description_en: Creates sound code labels in batches for a specified schedule
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定排程批量创建声码标签
name: BatchCreateSoundCodeLabel

parameters.help_en: The number of sound codes to create in batches. Valid values: 1 to 200. The system automatically generates a label for each sound code that consists of a random combination of letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 批量创建声码个数，数量为1～200个，系统将为每个声码自动生成由字母、数字随机组合的标签
parameters.name: total

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the schedule
parameters.name: schedule_code

parameters.help_en: The batch description. The description must be 1 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh: 批次描述，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符
parameters.name: description

Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The unique identifier of the sound code label batch
Data.description_zh: 声码标签批次唯一标识

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
